title: Efficient Generative Retrieval for E-commerce Search with Semantic Cluster IDs and Expert-Guided RL
abstract: arXiv:2605.14434v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative retrieval offers a promising alternative by unifying the fragmented multi-stage retrieval process into a single end-to-end model. However, its practical adoption in industrial e-commerce search remains challenging, given the massive and dynamic product catalogs, strict latency requirements, and the need to align retrieval with downstream ranking goals. In this work, we propose a retrieval framework tailored for real-world recall scenarios, positioning generative retrieval as a recall-stage supplement rather than an end-to-end replacement. Our method, CQ-SID (Category-and-Query constrained Semantic ID), employs category-aware and query-item contrastive learning along with Residual Quantized VAEs to encode items into hierarchical semantic cluster identifiers, significantly reducing beam search complexity. translated_title: 基于语义聚类ID与专家引导强化学习的电商搜索高效生成式检索
translated_abstract: 生成式检索通过将碎片化的多阶段检索过程统一为单一的端到端模型，提供了一种极具前景的替代方案。然而，面对庞大且动态变化的商品目录、严格的延迟要求，以及检索与下游排序目标对齐的需求，生成式检索在工业级电商搜索中的实际落地仍面临诸多挑战。在本工作中，我们提出了一个面向真实召回场景的检索框架，将生成式检索定位为召回阶段的补充手段，而非端到端的替代方案。我们的方法CQ-SID（类目与查询约束的语义ID）采用类目感知与查询-商品对比学习，并结合残差量化VAE，将商品编码为层次化的语义聚类标识符，从而显著降低了束搜索的复杂度。此外，我们还开发了EG-GRPO（专家引导的群体相对策略优化），这是一种强化学习方法……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CQ-SID方法，通过类目感知对比学习与残差量化VAE将商品编码为层次化语义聚类ID以大幅降低束搜索复杂度，并引入专家引导的强化学习方法EG-GRPO，将生成式检索定位为工业级电商搜索召回阶段的高效补充方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CQ-SID, which encodes items into hierarchical semantic cluster IDs via category-aware and query-item contrastive learning with Residual Quantized VAEs to significantly reduce beam search complexity, combined with EG-GRPO, an expert-guided reinforcement learning method, positioning generative retrieval as an efficient recall-stage supplement for industrial e-commerce search.
